TMF_PFAS: ("trophic magnification" OR TMF) AND (PFAS OR PFOS OR PFOA OR perfluor*)
BAF_PFAS_field: (bioaccumulation OR BAF OR "biota-sediment") AND (PFAS OR PFOS OR PFOA OR perfluor*) AND ("food web" OR field OR wild)
